payload.text: Cldr releases as pplr does (decision 27): devbin installed with release.after: bin/devbin post-cut, a macos signer for its one binary from pplr's cmd/macos, the formula moved to assets mode, signed and notarised. Work in Cldr's repo. Outside it: Lamplight moves to Geodica/Certificates' APPLE_APP_PASSWORD, then its own is revoked. The first real run of pplr's post-cut is the next pplr release.
